s3.title: RV · boat · long stays

w2.title: Authorised supply

w3.title: Systems thinking

ges.metaTitle: Solar Energy (PV) — Rooftop, Ground, Agri-PV, Carport
ges.metaDesc: Turnkey solar from survey to commissioning: zoning and permits, project development, EPC and operations under one roof.
ges.title: Solar Power Plants
ges.intro: From rooftops to open fields, farmland to car parks — we design your plant, run its permits, build and operate it. Zoning, EIA and licensing included, end to end.

rooftop.title: Rooftop PV
rooftop.desc: Self-consumption on home and business roofs: cuts the bill at its source.

ground.title: Ground-Mount PV (Unlicensed)
ground.desc: 1–5 MW unlicensed generation: turns idle land into income.

agripv.title: Agri-PV
agripv.desc: Generation and farming on the same parcel: the sun covers irrigation loads.

carport.title: Carport PV
carport.desc: Parking shade becomes a power plant; a natural pair with EV charging.

aud1.title: Homes
aud1.desc: Turnkey rooftop PV for villas and detached homes — net metering and up to 90% bill savings. Full flow: the For Home page.

aud2.title: Commercial & Industrial
aud2.desc: Factories, warehouses, malls and agri businesses: lower OPEX, accelerated depreciation, corporate PPA options.

f1.q: Who runs the permits and licensing?
f1.a: We do. Zoning status, EIA exemption or application, call letter and connection agreement — every project-development step is in scope.

f2.a: Rooftop systems typically run 4–8 weeks from survey to commissioning; unlicensed ground projects take 3–6 months depending on the permit calendar.

bess.metaDesc: Energy storage from LFP home batteries to container ESS: uninterrupted power, higher self-consumption, peak shaving.
bess.title: Energy Storage Systems
bess.intro: Carry the sun's production into the evening: LFP battery systems that step in during outages and grow self-consumption — from homes to industrial scale.

aud1.title: Home
aud1.desc: Hybrid inverter + wall-mounted LFP battery: the house keeps running through outages, daytime production gets spent at night.

aud2.title: Commercial & Industrial
aud2.desc: Rack and container ESS: scalable capacity for peak shaving, demand management and grid services.

f1.q: Can storage be added to my existing PV system?
f1.a: Usually yes — by moving to a hybrid inverter or with an AC-coupled add-on unit. We measure the existing system during the survey and give a firm answer.

f2.q: How long do the batteries last?
f2.a: The LFP cells we use are 6,000+ cycle class — roughly 15 years at one charge-discharge a day. Capacity warranties are on the product cards.

heatpump.metaTitle: Heat Pumps — Heating, Cooling, Hot Water and Pools
heatpump.metaDesc: Air-to-water heat pumps: one efficient system for underfloor heating, hot water and pool heating. Paired with PV, your heating runs on sunshine.
heatpump.title: Heat Pumps
heatpump.intro: Heating, cooling, hot water and underfloor circuits in one system: heat pumps turn each unit of electricity into 3–4 units of heat. With PV on your roof, your heating comes from the sun.

aud1.title: Homes
aud1.desc: Gas-free comfort in villas and detached homes: quiet monoblock units that pair with underfloor heating and radiators.

aud2.title: Business
aud2.desc: Central hot water and climate control for hotels, dorms and sports facilities; cascade setups for high capacity.

pool.title: Pool Heat Pumps
pool.desc: Stretch the season from April to November at villa and hotel pools: R290, soft-start pool heat pumps hold the water at the temperature you choose.

f1.q: Does a heat pump work in an older building?
f1.a: It does — what matters is the heat-load calculation. We measure insulation and the existing plumbing during the survey and size accordingly, raising flow temperatures where needed.

f2.q: Why install it together with PV?
f2.a: The heat pump's consumption is covered by the sun: heating costs come off your roof, not your bill. We size both systems in a single project.

evcharge.metaDesc: 7.4–22 kW AC at home, 30–400 kW DC fast charging at work: design, installation and carport PV integration.
evcharge.title: EV Charging Stations
evcharge.intro: Charge overnight at home and during the day at work: from AC wallboxes to DC fast-charging parks, we design, install and commission.

aud1.title: Home
aud1.desc: 7.4–22 kW AC wall charging: with meter capacity checks, load management and PV integration.

aud2.title: Business & Fleet
aud2.desc: OCPP-compliant DC fast charging for car parks and fleets; carport PV puts generation and charging in one structure.

f1.q: Is my home's electrical infrastructure enough?
f1.a: We measure meter power and panel capacity during the survey and file the capacity upgrade if one is needed. With load management, most homes install without extra power.

f2.q: Can I bill users for charging at my business?
f2.a: Yes — OCPP-compliant units connect to operator platforms for kWh-based billing; we guide you through the licensing requirements.
